notes.title: [Update] Beta 0.85f Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p][Update] Beta 0.85f Patch Notes[/p]
[list]
[*][p][Controller] L1 and R1 buttons are now also supported for engine control.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Controller] Added controller vibration. You can disable it in the settings.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Controller] Controller button prompts have been added to in-game interactions.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Controller] Retry Button in Expedition Mode is now accessible via controller.[/p][/*]
[*][p]Fixed an issue where dialogue could be skipped too quickly.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Expedition Mode] Good news! The explosion radius of the parrot bomb has been slightly reduced.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Battle Mode] Fixed an issue where controllers could be swapped.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Battle Mode] Players who had their ring taken will not block others' paths for a while.[/p][/*]
[*][p][Battle Mode] Fixed an issue with incorrect acceleration values in the game settings.[/p][/*]
[/list]
[p] ⭐Finally, thank you all for participating in SteamNextFest! If you have any feedback, please feel free to share it on our Steam forum or [url="https://discord.com/invite/AdYpjDEqmW"]Discord[/url].[/p]
